model_output.verdict: A distribution supervisor with a clear path from picking to leading a 35-person night shift.
write_up: Your resume shows a clear move from order picker to Lead Associate to Shift Supervisor at Sierra Freight Distribution. A recruiter can see what your night shift handles and how big the team is. The main question is what your scheduling, training and other work changed.

The night-shift line is your strongest: it names the team and the work across picking, packing and loading. Your work history is easy to follow, and the OSHA and forklift certifications belong with this story.

Let's start with the current role. Add the order volume you schedule for and what the new leads learn, then explain your part in the scanner rollout. If you can tie any of that work to a result you know, include it.
